newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China police smash fake passport ring - HK paper.
newsitem.headline: China police smash fake passport ring - HK paper.

text.p: Police in China's southern city of Guangzhou have smashed a passport counterfeit syndicate and arrested two Hong Kong men, a Hong Kong newspaper said on Sunday.
Guangzhou police seized hundreds of fake Chinese and foreign passports, mainland exit visas and more than 130 million yuan (US$156,000), the Sing Pao newspaper said.
The counterfeit passports and exit permits were used by mainland Chinese to smuggle themselves out of the country and sneak into Hong Kong, it said.
Many mainland Chinese yearn to emigrate to Hong Kong where living standards are higher.
